mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns due to reduced cost of capital for firms and increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 4.5% and INDPRO < 100, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong retail sales (RSAFS) above the 90th percentile of historical values signal overextended consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, when RSAFS is above the 90th percentile, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 275, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 275, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 10th percentiles signal a broad-based consumer demand collapse, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where RSAFS < 10th percentile and HOUST < 10th percentile, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
